I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **2025-11-03**.

- **Source for the date:** Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02 says "ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's own cutover recap note (2025-12-08) also gives November 3 as the official handoff.
- **Practical takeover:** That recap also says Bettina kept running the account day to day through Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 if the tracker needs the date he actually started doing the work.

Both files are public.
